findings.requirement: Upstream Karpathy principles apply to ANY coding task (writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing, debugging). ML/numerical work is optional, not prerequisite.
findings.expected_behavior: Dispatch routes general coding tasks (bug fix, refactor, review, debug) to karpathy-skills
findings.actual_behavior: Dispatch only routes on keywords: prototype|sketch|numpy|torch|first principle
findings.root_cause: dispatch.sh line 47 heuristic too narrow; upstream intent not fully understood during integration
evidence: plugin-catalog/code/karpathy-skills/SKILL.md lines 21-24: 'Behavioral guidance for any coding task... ML/numerical work is one optional application'
unified-integration/scripts/dispatch.sh line 47: 'if echo "$lc" | grep -qE "(prototype|sketch|numpy|torch|first principle)"; then echo "karpathy-skills"; return; fi'
unified-integration/prompts/consolidated-system-prompt.txt lines 20-30: Principles included but not auto-activated for general coding
reproduction_steps: Run: bash unified-integration/scripts/dispatch.sh "fix a bug in authentication"
Run: bash unified-integration/scripts/dispatch.sh "prototype a neural network"
findings.production_impact: General coding tasks miss Karpathy's 4 principles (Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution), reducing code quality and increasing over-engineering risk
findings.relevant_industry_reference: Upstream multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills README: 'These principles apply to all coding tasks'
findings.recommended_remediation: Expand dispatch.sh keywords to include general coding: fix|bug|refactor|review|debug|write code|implement|simplif|clean code|over-engineer
findings.verification_method: Run dispatch.sh with test prompts; verify karpathy-skills selected for general coding tasks

findings.requirement: Preflight Mode 1 (host-native selector) should work for claude-code and codex hosts
findings.expected_behavior: Host adapter supplies ae_native_selection event payload; runtime validates and uses it
findings.actual_behavior: No shipped adapter supplies ae_native_selection; every Mode 1 prompt falls back to Mode 0 with diagnosis 'mode1_native_selection_unavailable'
findings.root_cause: Mode 1 specified in CONTRACT 8.5 but no host adapter implementation exists
evidence: unified-integration/scripts/adaptive_preflight.py lines 1143-1154: Mode 1 checks for ae_native_selection, raises PreflightError if missing
adaptive_preflight.py line 1228-1231: status_report() shows effective_mode=0, diagnosis='mode1_native_selection_unavailable'
No host adapter code found implementing pre-inference selection surface
findings.production_impact: Mode 1 adds configuration complexity without function; users cannot benefit from host-native selection
findings.recommended_remediation: Either implement ae_native_selection in Claude Code/Codex adapters, or remove Mode 1 from config schema and documentation
acceptance_criteria: Option A: Mode 1 works with claude-code and codex (ae_native_selection supplied)
Option B: Mode 1 removed from VALID_MODES, config schema, docs
findings.verification_method: Configure mode=1; verify selection works or mode removed

findings.requirement: Priority rules for overlapping clean-code principles must be enforced
findings.expected_behavior: Only one clean-code voice active per task (Karpathy, Superpowers, ECC, Ponytail)
findings.actual_behavior: Priority rules documented in SKILL.md line 88-89 but not enforced in dispatch/runtime
findings.root_cause: Rules documented but no runtime enforcement mechanism
evidence: plugin-catalog/code/karpathy-skills/SKILL.md lines 88-89: 'Ponytail, Superpowers, and ECC clean-code membahas domain yang beririsan. Ikuti aturan prioritas proyek; gunakan satu suara'
dispatch.sh routes independently; no deduplication of overlapping principles
reproduction_steps: Run dispatch on task that could match multiple clean-code skills
Observe: Multiple skills may be recommended without priority resolution
findings.production_impact: Duplicate/conflicting instructions in context; token waste; inconsistent behavior
findings.recommended_remediation: Add priority logic in dispatch.sh or runtime skill selection; define clear precedence: Karpathy (general) > Superpowers (workflow) > ECC (config) > Ponytail (linting)
acceptance_criteria: General coding task → Karpathy selected, others suppressed
findings.verification_method: Test dispatch on overlapping scenarios; verify single clean-code voice

findings.requirement: CI timeout should exceed test duration with margin

findings.actual_behavior: ECC test suite ~45min, CI timeout 45min (risk of flaky timeout)

evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 187: timeout-minutes: 45
ECC tests observed ~45min duration
reproduction_steps: Run ECC tests locally multiple times
findings.production_impact: Risk of CI false failures due to timeout
findings.relevant_industry_reference: CI best practices: timeout > 2x typical duration
findings.recommended_remediation: Increase timeout to 60min or parallelize more aggressively
findings.verification_method: Check CI config; run ECC tests
